Asgard is the home of the Asgardians/gods. Norse goddesses are called: Asynjur and Norse Gods are called Aesir. Odin is the ruler of Asgard, and his wife Frigg (or Frigga) is the Queen. Inside the gates lies Valhalla.…

Heimdall Heimdall is the guardian of Asgard, he guards the Bifrost bridge. He blows his horn when Ragnarok comes. He's also an Aesir. Heimdall can see and hear across time. Odin Odin is the all father of all of the Norse gods and goddesses. He's the ruler of asgard and weilds an enchanted spear: Gungnir. He has 2 ravens called Huginn and Munin. Valhalla Valhalla could be seen right after you open the gates to Asgard. It has 540 wide doors and the roof is made of golden shields. page.overview:
What is Asgard?

Asgard is the home of the Asgardians/gods. Norse goddesses are called: Asynjur and Norse Gods are called Aesir. Odin is the ruler of Asgard, and his wife Frigg (or Frigga) is the Queen. Inside the gates lies Valhalla. Category:Places
